title: Change all white text to black for readability in light mode

requirements.summary: Update all white text colors to black throughout the website for better readability against light backgrounds in light mode
acceptanceCriteria: All white text (#FFFFFF, rgb(255,255,255), or equivalent) is changed to black (#000000 or dark gray) in light mode
The 'Achievements' heading with 'REWARDS' text is clearly readable with black color
All section headings, body text, and descriptive text are black in light mode
Text maintains proper contrast and readability against the light purple/lavender backgrounds
Dark mode text colors remain unchanged (white text for dark backgrounds)

file_operations.description: Update text color classes in HeroSection to use foreground color tokens that resolve to black in light mode. Change title, subtitle, and button text to use semantic color classes that adapt to theme mode.
Update GameplaySection text colors to black in light mode. Change section heading, feature card titles, and descriptions to use theme-aware foreground color classes.

Update RewardsSection text colors including the 'Achievements' heading and 'REWARDS' text to black in light mode. Modify all headings, reward descriptions, and statistics text to use foreground color tokens.
Update ShopInfoSection text colors to black in light mode. Change section heading, item titles, descriptions, and pricing text to use theme-adaptive foreground colors.
Update CallToAction text colors to black in light mode. Modify heading and call-to-action message text to use semantic foreground color classes.
Update Footer text colors to black in light mode. Change brand name, server IP, links, and copyright text to use foreground color tokens that resolve to black in light theme.

requirements.summary: Update frontend/src/index.css to change all white text color CSS custom properties to black for light theme mode
acceptanceCriteria: Light theme foreground color custom properties are set to black or dark gray
Card text colors in light mode use black for proper readability
Accent text colors maintain appropriate contrast in light mode
Dark theme text colors remain white for proper visibility on dark backgrounds

file_operations.description: Update CSS custom properties in the :root selector to set light mode foreground colors to black (#000000 or oklch(0.2 0 0)). Modify --foreground, --card-foreground, --primary-foreground, --secondary-foreground, --accent-foreground, and --muted-foreground to use black tones. Ensure dark mode (.dark) selectors retain white foreground colors.

requirements.summary: Update frontend/tailwind.config.js to define black text colors for light mode theme configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind theme configuration includes black text colors for light mode
foreground, card-foreground, and other text-related color tokens use black in light mode
Dark mode configuration retains white text colors
All theme color tokens properly support both light and dark modes

file_operations.description: Update the theme.extend.colors configuration to set foreground-related color tokens to black values in light mode. Modify foreground, card.foreground, primary.foreground, secondary.foreground, accent.foreground, and muted.foreground to use black OKLCH values (oklch(0.2 0 0) or similar). Verify dark mode variants retain white foreground colors.
